why: The rectangle of every PAD_ESCAPE_RUN_<REF> width-licence rule area, DECLARED before the router runs. A barrel is a point and its area may be drawn around it; a RUN has an extent, so an area drawn around whatever the router laid would be a licence whose size the router chooses. route_maze_batch.py --relief-run-area draws exactly these rectangles and maze3d._run_licence refuses any run that does not fit one.
